'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Chris Terwilliger LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet '''Chris Twilliger'''; dest [[Chris Terwilliger]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Center Of Tyranny (V) (Virtual Block 7)|Center Of Tyranny (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
